svg.aria-label: Comb, a worker bee in a hard hat, stands beside a hive with its side cut away. Inside hang three wooden comb frames, labelled SM 0, SM 1 and SM 2. On each frame small worker bees stand in straight rows that move together, a formation called a warp. Comb points at the frames like a guide on a tour.
